notes: All four complete PNGs were opened and visually inspected. Titles, axis labels, tick precision, legends, error bars, shared-control and denominator footnotes are readable.
Bias panels use relative percentage points for theta/sigma and absolute units for zero-truth mu. Small positive and negative effects are retained.
Coverage panels retain paired all-planned differences and state that collapsed empirical normal intervals do not prove population equality.
RMSE-ratio plots display log-delta uncertainty and the same common-valid subset for both metrics; spacing panels show the floor changes clipping without renormalization.
CV=0 is identified as one shared exact control; 24,000 physical realizations are not claimed to be 24,000 independent groups.
